title: Intel and ASML report progress on High NA EUV manufacturing
summary: Intel reports more than one million wafers processed across certification, testing, research and selected production layers. The announcement describes manufacturing readiness, not a measured industry-wide capacity increase.

title: TSMC reports August revenue of NT$514.81 billion
summary: TSMC reports consolidated August revenue up 10.1% month on month and 53.3% year on year. Revenue is a financial observation and does not identify physical wafer output or a supply disruption.

title: VSMC opens its first 300mm fab in Singapore
summary: NXP and VIS announce the opening of their VSMC fab in Tampines. The stated target is 44,000 wafers per month by 2029; that future target is not current production capacity.

title: Micron publishes fiscal fourth-quarter and full-year 2026 results
summary: Micron reports record fiscal 2026 results and plans increased investment in technology, products and manufacturing. These company financial results do not establish the magnitude of a physical memory shortage or its downstream effects.

title: GlobalFoundries and TSMC agree on US silicon-interposer supply
summary: GlobalFoundries announces a multi-year $2 billion manufacturing agreement for TSMC's CoWoS packaging ecosystem, with capacity expansion planned in Malta, New York. The announcement does not quantify currently available additional output.

title: TSMC reports September revenue of NT$511.86 billion
summary: TSMC reports September consolidated revenue down 0.6% month on month and up 54.6% year on year. This is a revenue release, not the third-quarter earnings release scheduled for October 15.

title: Samsung issues preliminary third-quarter 2026 earnings guidance
summary: Samsung publishes consolidated third-quarter sales and operating-profit estimates. These preliminary company-wide figures are not semiconductor-segment results or measurements of fabrication output.
